_readme: Chronological registry of every floatation/buoy iteration, oldest first. To add a new iteration: append ONE entry (files + optional hydro) and run `python run_studies.py --explorer-only`. Order in this list is the order of the explorer's slider. See README.md.

iterations.name: v1 — earliest concept
iterations.note: Centre hole goes through (it floods, no buoyancy). Mass estimated from the STEP volume; housing and payload as current.

iterations.name: v2
iterations.note: Centre hole goes through (it floods, no buoyancy). Mass estimated from the STEP volume; housing and payload as current.

iterations.name: v3 — first snap-fit concept
iterations.note: Three sections stacked; each top stud (25.4 mm) sits in the next section's bottom socket. Mass estimated from the STEP volume; housing and payload as current.

iterations.name: v4 — hollow snap concept
iterations.note: Three sections stacked, butt joint: the v4 STEP is a plain cup (open ring cavity, no stud or socket), so there is no connector to model. Each cavity is sealed by the section above; the top one is open and floods. Mass estimated; housing and payload as current.

iterations.name: v5 — bottom, middle and top sections stacked
iterations.note: Bottom, middle and top sections stacked in that order; the thin posts and tab under and beside the cap are removed so the cap sits flush. The payload is simulated as mass inside the central cavity (no capsule), the cavity counted as sealed. Mass estimated from the STEP volume.

iterations.name: v7 — octagon (bottom, DFM)
iterations.note: Bottom piece with two of the second piece stacked on it. Butt joint. Mass estimated; housing and payload as current.

iterations.name: v9 — snap assembly, three chassis connectors
iterations.note: Chassis with the wedge copied to six, 60 degrees apart. Masses estimated; housing and payload as current.

iterations.name: v9 — bottom ring variant
iterations.note: Chassis and bottom ring as exported. The bottom ring may overlap the chassis in the STEP, which would double-count mass. Masses estimated; housing and payload as current.

iterations.name: Wedge, snap/keyhole (Master V3)
iterations.note: Chassis with the wedge and the wedge bottom each copied to six around it. Masses estimated; housing and payload as current.

iterations.name: Wedge, bolted (Master V3 Copy 1)
iterations.note: Chassis with the wedge copied to six around it. Masses estimated; housing and payload as current.

iterations.name: Bolted wedge v4 (chassis, wedge, caps)
iterations.note: Chassis, chassis cap, and six each of wedge, wedge cap and wedge bottom around it. Masses estimated; housing and payload as current.

iterations.name: Full buoy assembly v5 (3.0 in caps)
Full buoy assembly v6 (1.5 in caps, ballast pipe)
Full buoy assembly v7 (larger-flange housing)
iterations.note: Same parts as v6 per cad/README.md; the solver still uses the v6 cap geometry. v7 was not diffed against v6 beyond its part list.

iterations.name: Mushroom-profile printed float (no foam, no ballast stem)
iterations.note: Float 702 g as reported by John Ryan; electronics, pod, coating and mooring masses are the printed-float study's budget so numbers compare across designs. The STEP holds the float and the housing.
